derivation: assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of G1492 (εἴδω);

occurrences.text: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
